newsitem.title: USA: Tampa, Fla., approves $426 million budget for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Tampa, Fla., approves $426 million budget for 1997.

text.p: Tampa, Fla., City Council approved a $427 million budget that raises garbage and sewer fees but leaves property tax rates unchanged, the St. Petersburg Times said Friday.
The fiscal 1997 budget will raise residential garbage service bills by about $1 a month and sewer bills by about $5 a month.
The council rejected a proposed 15 percent fee increase for parking at city lots, which would have come two years after the city raised those fees by 23 percent.

The budget includes $2.1 million for 54 new park employees assigned to clean up overgrown and litter-stren property citywide. For the eighth consecutive year, the budget leaves property taxes at $6.54 per $1,000 of assessed value.
